exposure: Hadlock method for estimated fetal weight (EFW) calculation
Salomon et al method for EFW calculation
outcome: small for gestational age (SGA) at birth
cohort: The study participants were singleton, nonanomalous, well-dated fetuses who had an ultrasound examination within 2 weeks of delivery at the institution between January 1, 2013, and March 31, 2017.
finding: The Hadlock method predicted birth weight percentile more accurately than the INTG or Salomon methods and performed comparably with INTG for predicting SGA at birth when ROC-derived cutoffs were used.
